reviews.text:
UPDATE 10/04/26: We are still extremely satisfied with our Vet's & staff here at the Jones road location! Highly recommend if you and your pet have needs!
We have decided this is our Vet of choice. Our boy Archer, Rhodesian Ridgeback, just loves everyone there. Just as they love seeing him. Even after we had to have a procedure done on his rear end near his tail. They took excellent care of him! And we appreciate that do very much. Even after all that Archer still goes in for an overnight stay occasionally and he has no fear or anxiety about going in there. That is a wonderful thing 😁

Dr knight was more than incredible. Friendly, funny, extremely professional and great with both our French bulldogs. We travelled all the way from Canada and are relocating to Costa Rica. He was extremely helpful and knowledgeable getting us on the right track. We had a rough couple of days and the dogs were stuck in a vehicle for 3 days and they loved him. His staff and coworkers are all incredible also the vet technician was so friendly and great with our dogs and very friendly. Every person we had talked to at the front desk went out of their way to help us out and not get frustrated with us calling 3-4 times checking up on the appointment. Not a single soul in this establishment deserves anything less than 5 stars ! Thank you to everyone that made us feel at home and comfortable during this difficult move. God bless !!

We took our cat in because they accept walk ins and my normal vet couldn't see him right away.  It took 3 hours from time we got there until we left but we were a walkin so cant complain about that too much. They confirmed he didn't have a urinary blockage,  but suggested a lot of lab work.  The labs (blood and urine) were over $600 to do, which was way more expensive than I've ever been charged for blood work. We went ahead because we wanted to see what was causing his symptoms right away.  That was September 19th.  It is September 28th.  We still have not received any information though I've called twice asking for updates despite being told on Sept 19th "the vet doesnt know how to take a day off."  The tech was super patient and nice,  but being in limbo for 9 days seems pretty excessive.  Would not recommend.

Edit: I gave a 2 star review and conveniently they called within 2 hours with another vet to give results. So dropping to 1 star because I shouldn't have to give negative feedback to get results and I will not be coming back with any of my animals.

First Time visit was the best. I really appreciate the staff and the doctors looking over my dog Prince. I’m glad that they were able to help me take care of his eye and his skin irritation. I really appreciate the doctors and stuff. Well great customer service skills. I definitely recommend someone coming to this beautiful place. Thank you.
Good people took exelant care of my cat Fluffy

This is my old Vet office in Houston and they are all amazing there . The doctors and vet techs were so kind in helpful with my dogs . Especially when I had to put down my dog Daisy that was very difficult . Also when I took Zoey to get her tumor looked at and told it needed to be fixed . My ex did not want to pay to get her fixed or her tumor removed . Well I met a new guy that had my baby Zoey fixed and her tumor removed… so I wanted to let you know she is finally all better . I live in Flagstaff now and Zoey and I are happier than we ever have been . Thanks again for all your help and your love of animals like me .. Have a blessed day 😇!
Great customer service

I had a wonderful experience at VCA Jones clinic! From the moment we arrived, the staff was friendly, caring, and professional. They took the time to listen to my concerns, thoroughly explain everything. The staff gave me the peace of mind I needed.
Quick, very transparent and simple process with my check up on my overgrooming cat.
We’ve been with VCA for about 3 years now and we truly appreciate the care and love they give our cat. The vet techs are patient even when our cat is fussy.

Dr Yonkers has such a lovely bedside manner and is incredibly patient with our very nervous pup. She is always kind, compassionate and thorough, and takes the time to make him feel as comfortable as possible while also explaining everything clearly to us. It’s obvious how much she genuinely cares about the animals she treats. We’re so happy to have found such a wonderful, caring vet and would absolutely recommend her to anyone looking for someone they can trust with their baby.
I love the technicians here. They are always so friendly and helpful. I wouldn't take my pets anywhere else.

I have such a great experience at this VCA location every visit! Jacob and Dr Fisher are amazing at what they do. They both took the time to listen to my concerns and made sure to give Tobi the best care possible. It’s always comforting to know my Tobi is in good hands, and I truly felt that here!
Love Vca jones, you can tell they care about our animals.

worst customer service, they want to put you on hold for a long time, so call and ask at once regardless of whether they tell you a thousand times that they will put you on hold, because the service they have is very limited so you don’t have to waste your time here
Great care for my new pet
I love VCA 4 coco. Need nails cut
Great Service and friendly staff close to home will definitely bring my frenchie back….
Friendly staff!

Every time we leave here we have the most amazing experience! Today’s tech, Anahi, like all the other techs was so helpful! They always put us at ease being new time puppy owners. Doctor Yonkers was amazing too!

This is the only vet facility my little kitty boys have been to. Had to bring in Bear today for some ear issues and everyone here has been so friendly and informative. Ricky, the tech, has been so gentle with him and reassuring to me about his treatment. We will definitely be sticking to this location.
Excellent Service  Dr.Fisher & Team  Awesome 👌 …
I brought my pup and one of my kitties here. They received great care from Dr. Yonkers and Tammy, they were both very caring and gentle  I highly recommend VCA Jones.
We love bringing our cat to vca here on Jones Rd. They take such good care of “Phat Daddy”. They are fast and efficient. The staff is warm and welcoming.
Very cozy, welcoming and kind staff. Everything was quick and my babies was well cared. Clean clinic.

First time coming to this facility, I went in as a walk in on a Sunday, the staff and doctor were very attentive, I felt at ease with the care they provided for my cat that is currently fighting a uti. Thank you all.

I have taken my GSD here since we got her and they have been amazing with her. We has to put down 2 of our senior rescue cats recently and the staff was very careful and caring. I will continue to bring my annals here and would definitely recommend them. Ask for Dr Yonkers and/or Dr. Fisher. Absolutely great folks here
I just LOVE VCA Jones Road, all of the staff are always so friendly and accommodating and the Dr listens and truly try and help your pet feel better.
My dog Winston and I were Traveling through town needed a same day appointment they got me in the staff was great, left very satisfied after not knowing what to expect… 5 stars across the board

VCA Jones Road always finds a way to fit us in their schedule. I had a medical emergency for my dog and they squeezed me in promptly. As soon as we came in, Dr. Knight saw her and accessed her right away. My dog made a full recovery and Dr. Knight followed up and contacted me directly to see how my dog was doing. Would recommend !

I love the VCA, specifically this Location. I have been bringing my dog here since she was three months old and they have always taken really good care of her. Highly recommended. Especially the pet care club!

The greatest place I've ever taken my standard poodle! They are the kindest so caring and if you want and need awesome care for your fur baby take them here! Me and my Cocoa are so grateful for everyone there and such excellent care for her surgery! Thanks so much Dr Jordan and all the team!

Thank you for your feedback Andres! We appreciate your support and are grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet. If you'd like to share more about your experience, please contact us at vcacontactus@vca.com. 💙 …

Excellent care and service. I requested a travel certificate for my dog, and everything went perfectly; they were attentive and stayed on top of the entire process. Thank you so much—highly recommended.
I brought both of my cats in for an Exam and they did fantastic. Dr. Williamson is great and get straight to the point on what is needed.
Kind staff doctors are experienced
40 minutes late for an appointment in the morning
Dr. Williamson and her vet assistant took the most amazing care of my puppy. They are genuinely here for your animal's needs.
Took great care of our boy when he wasn’t doing well highly recommended.

I had a bad experience at VCA on Jones Rd.
The day before my cat’s emergency, I took him there for a complimentary exam. The staff, especially the girl I spoke with on the phone, seemed very nice and friendly. So when my cat had a urinary blockage the next morning, I rushed back at 7am.
But this time their attitude completely changed. When I asked how much the treatment would cost because I needed time to figure out payment, the same girl became very dismissive. She wouldn’t even give me a rough idea of the price. She kept walking to the back and left me standing there feeling ignored.
I eventually left and went to a smaller local clinic (Fonder Animal Hospital). They were the complete opposite — kind, compassionate, and very reasonable. They treated my cat right away and even let me leave him there while I went to get the money. They never ignored me or made me feel bad.
I highly recommend people support smaller local vet hospitals instead of these phony corporate places like VCA.
Been with this location for years, they always give the best care to my dachshund. Very friendly and professional staff, you can definitely tell they care about pet health!
Great wellness plan and great staff

Dr. SARA YONKERS is wonderful and compassionate.   I have had an ER visit with a kitten and  wellness  visits for my senior dog.  Every experience has made me feel like my animals have received excellent treatment.

I have seen 3 different veterinarians at this location and each visit I would rate as  a 5 star.

Thank you
My dog had an ear infection and the Dr and staff were very attentive and the prescription he gave cleared the problem up in 7 days
Great service! Fully explained everything and my pups needs. Thank you! Dr Williamson and Charlene.

We have been coming to the VCA Jones location for years, and drive about an hour for care. They always treat us like family. I still have a gift they gave us when we lost our first baby in 2016. They are worth the drive, and we will never change locations.
Coda was pretty scared but the staff really calmed him down, they were great!

We've used a couple of vets in the past with mixed feelings about them, but VCA is the best!  The staff is helpful and friendly.  The veterinarians are great.  We've never had any issue with them and look forward to a long relationship with them since our cat is young.

This is Mitzi Uvacek writing this horrible review.  We had a 2pm appointment, specifically with Dr. Yonkers, for our new pup. However, we didn't even get seen today!  At 1:45, I was told Yonkers had a meeting and was unavailable, but I could see a different vet. I told her if I had wanted to see a different vet, then I would have scheduled with one. We aririved at 1:45 pm to do paper work since our pup had not been there before, and that was all good. After waiting 45 min I walked up to the counter and ask when we might be seen.  The young lady at the counter said that we were next, but then they called in another one of the pups first. That set me off.  I told them they had five minutes to get my pup in, or I was leaving.  I sat back down to wait.  They then called someone else!   I was done!   My pup, my son, and myself had been there 1 hour and 10 min, with our new puppy crying, whining, biting, and barking, because she was terrified we were dumping her like her previous owners did!  When we left, I said we would find another vet, and no one said a word!  They just looked at me like they didn' t give two craps about my pup. So if you make an appointment at Jone's Road VCA Animal Hospital, pack a lunch, because you are going to be there a while, if you even get seen!  We loved Dr. Yonkers, but will never step foot in that place again. If I could give them a zero I would.

Awesome service. Very detailed information was given with preventative advice and things to look for in regards to very small dogs specifically. I had originally chose another place for my dogs first exam but ended up changing my mind and im glad I did. Much better experience than the petstore clinics. Her vet was Jordan F. and Anna. Get the insurance. Its worth it!

I am deeply disappointed with the care my dog received from Dr. Sara Yonkers.and Dr Taryn Williamson
My dog was prescribed medication without a thorough evaluation of his overall health. Shortly after starting the medication, he developed serious symptoms, including coughing, fatigue, loss of appetite, and difficulty breathing.
My daughter brought him back to the clinic to report these side effects, but her concerns were dismissed, and she was told she was overreacting. No additional examination or diagnostic testing was performed at that time.
Over the following two weeks, my dog’s condition continued to worsen. He eventually became extremely weak and was later diagnosed with heart failure, high blood pressure, and fluid in the lungs, which ultimately led to his death.
The role of the medications in this case
Temaril-P
•	Contains prednisolone (a steroid)
•	It can:
•	Cause fluid retention
•	Increase blood pressure
•	Worsen underlying heart disease
👉 If a dog has heart disease and is not evaluated beforehand
→ the risk becomes significantly higher
Fluconazole
•	Has less direct impact on the heart
•	However:
•	It can make the dog feel weak or lose appetite
•	It may put additional stress on the body
🧠 The most important points to note

👉 There are two major concerns in your situation:
1. Lack of thorough examination before prescribing medication
•	No proper heart evaluation (auscultation, X-ray, ultrasound, etc.)
•	Yet a steroid was prescribed for two weeks
👉 This is a point that could be professionally questionable
2. Ignoring warning signs

You observed:
•	Difficulty breathing
•	Weakness
👉 But the veterinarian said you were “overreacting”
I trusted this clinic to provide proper care and to take my concerns seriously. I believe that a more thorough evaluation and timely response to his symptoms could have made a difference.
I hope the clinic takes situations like this more seriously in the future so that other pet owners do not have to go through the same experience.

Awesome humans working here! So accommodating to myself & my 105lb GSD. From making the appointment,  to helping me upon arrival, understanding of Church's idiosyncrasies (dog selective, high prey drive, no children -- ALL due to the abuse he suffered in his 1st yr of life). He's super sweet & is well-mannered nature, which he showed. The fantastic vet has a husky & GSD. The Tech was A++. Shall be switching all my pups to VCA Jones Rd.
This veterinary clinic helped my kitten no matter what. Thank you for loving what you do and for being there to help animals. I owe you so much.

We originally brought our sweet pup Amelia here, and Dr. Yonkers was absolutely amazing. When Amelia passed, every single person we interacted with showed such compassion and kindness and it truly meant more to us than we can put into words.

Now our pups Fred, Whiskey, and Hammy see Dr. Escobar and Dr. Knight, and they are just as incredible. The level of care, attention, and genuine love they show for our pets gives us so much peace of mind.

Their hours are super convenient, and the Care Club has been a game changer for us. Being on a budget, it’s such a relief knowing we’re getting consistent, quality care without feeling overwhelmed by unexpected costs.

We are so grateful to have found a vet team that treats our pets like family!

VCA Jones Animal Clinic provided an outstanding experience. Their team demonstrated excellent customer service, showing both professionalism and genuine care. They were patient, attentive, and ensured my pet felt comfortable throughout the visit.

Vca is one of the best that I’ve ever been to they’re always friendly and kind and always make sure that they take care of what’s needed for your furry baby today I saw Dr. Fisher and Charlene and they’re always so so nice no matter who helps you!
Charlie, thank you for taking the time to share this feedback! ☺️ 💜  …

Consistently kind and efficient staff who go above and beyond. They were able to see me very quickly, and when I got stuck in traffic they were flexible and accommodating despite my late arrival.
Even long after the appointment, they’ve been exceptionally helpful in getting his medication refilled. So glad I took my cat Calvin to see them!!

This location is lacking in the communication department.
My dogs medication is always on hold bc she needs this vaccine or exam before we can write the script
So I take my dog in. Long and behold, she gets the vaccine and then I’m told 3 days later. She needs an exam and we can’t write the stripe for you until this is done.

Why didn’t you just do it all at once then??!  I’d go somewhere else.

I was recommended this place from a dear friend that has brought their dogs here for several years and I am incredibly happy with their service the doctors are so nice and helpful they're excellent on giving you all the information and upfront cost they do work very well with you let me know what your pet is going to be needing and going through I can't see myself taking my animal anywhere else I love this place very informative and warm I wish I could get my primary doctor to act this way 😂

Dr. Yonkers and her team are absolutely amazing. My kitten had to have intestinal surgery and they were able to take care of everything from surgery to at home care. They saved my kittens life and I couldn't thank them more for that ❤️ all the staff is very caring and attentive to your fur babies. Highly recommended!

It saddens me to leave a highly negative review for a team I genuinely care about, but I feel a responsibility to share our experience so others in the community are informed and can hopefully avoid going through a similar situation with their furry family member.

After consulting multiple veterinary professionals and reviewing accepted veterinary medical guidance, we learned that, according to the Texas Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners, veterinarians in Texas are required to provide care that meets the generally accepted professional standard of care for the condition being treated.

Unfortunately, the level of care and attentiveness we experienced did not align with these standards. We had to rush our pet to an emergency veterinary clinic due to nearly losing him shortly after his vet visit. He required at least three days of emergency hospitalization, resulting in thousands of dollars in medical bills. While our cat was hospitalized in the ICU, we also learned of underlying heart issues that had either been dismissed or not brought to our attention during our visit at VCA, along with other protocols that should have been followed by VCA given the severity of his condition.

I reached out to VCA privately multiple times to communicate what happened and to seek clarification or accountability, but we did not receive a response, which ultimately led me to share this experience publicly for the sake of the community.

I do want to acknowledge that the front desk staff, veterinary assistants, and vet technicians are attentive, hardworking, and kind. Their efforts do not go unnoticed and are truly appreciated. However, despite their dedication, nearly losing our family pet and seeing him in significant pain, without a sense that the seriousness of the situation was fully recognized or addressed, led us to seek care elsewhere with a more attentive and proactive veterinarian.

I am leaving this review solely in the hope of preventing a similar experience for others and in the hope that VCA on Jones improves its attentiveness, communication, and accountability moving forward for both pets and their families.

Dr. Fisher took amazing care of our Lucy. The whole staff is caring and she had to get stitches and In any emergency or just regular care I will recommend them hands down to take great care of your fur babies.

Excellent vets office. All staff are wonderful, helpful and willing to educate you in a way that's simple to understand. I was able to make an appointment online for what I needed to get done for my pup. They helped me get a discount on flea, tick and heartworm meds by getting them mailed directly to me! We have signed up for the senior plan, it's like a monthly membership that help covers things my pet will need as she ages. They listen to your concerns and make you feel as comfortable as they do your pet. 🐾

We see Dr. Yonkers for our dogs and she is very thorough-which we appreciate! Our tech at this specific appointment was Charlene and she was kind and patient with our little senior dog (which again is greatly appreciated)
Good and fast service
really loved it here went for the first time and they did amazing with my cat would definitely go here!

I love them they are great Dr Yonkers is amazing she took care of my Timo and is now taking care of my Archie. Benjamin and PJ  also amazing !! In reality the  whole staff is ! I highly recommend them his VCA !!

Kimberly… Dr Knight… entire staff… They are living proof that there are angels amongst us!
Roxy presented with a challenging situation that required surgery.  Kimberly and her amazing staff walked us through the process each step of the way.  Dr Knight did amazing work on Roxy’s leg and we are happy to report that she is now walking on her own again.
Beyond the amazing service provided, there was real human kindness and compassion.  This is more than just a business here!  Great people who do great things!
Thank you from Roxy and her friends!
The staff is always very professional and caring for my pet!
The staff here are awesome.  They really care about their fur baby patients.  Definitely recommend and they offer great  affordable plans.

My dog was sick with an eye infection and they attended her well and with much care. My dog rosey came out happier than nervous, I’m super happy this place is somewhere that can welcome your pet with excitement and comfort.
Excellent attention to our baby. Very professional and sweet to all the animals we saw in there
Love this place. My dog who is always scared is always at ease here. The doctors, assistants front desk and groomers are the only ones i will trust for my pet. Thank you all
VCA Jones Road has cared for my pets and does a great job. I definitely recommend this location.
Quick and compassionate service!

0/10 — Absolutely would NOT recommend.

If I could give ZERO stars I would!

We brought our dog in extremely sick, and from the start everything felt like money over care. The nurse even asked about microchipping during an emergency. They also said they “couldn’t take his temperature” because he “literally jumped” — of course he did, they put a thermometer up his butt while he was in pain. When we offered to hold him so they could try again, the nurse said, “I mean, we can try,” which should’ve been their first approach.

They pushed a long list of charges, including an extra $100 just to “interpret” an X-ray. Then they told us he urgently needed a $7k–$9k surgery and even said to “prepare to say your goodbyes.”
When they brought our dog back out, he had tears coming from his eyes, his testicles were very red, and he was clearly distressed from sedation.

The next morning we went for a second opinion at Pet Check Up, and thank God we did. That vet reviewed the same X-ray and did her own examinations and immediately said he did NOT need surgery — just medication and monitoring. Our dog improved within hours and started acting like himself again.

Meanwhile, the original vet called saying he was “curious to see what’s inside him,” even though he insisted the night before that he knew exactly what it was. Even after hearing our dog was improving, he still pushed surgery. That confirmed it was never about our pet — just money.

This place was careless, insensitive, and full of pressure. The only good I got out of it was the front desk girls! They were kind and caring!

If you love your pets, avoid this place and go to Pet Check Up instead. They’re caring, honest, and won’t force unnecessary procedures. They are only a few minutes down the road from this place!

My dog is in pain, blind, and can't hold her bladder anymore... I made an appointment for end of life care for her..shes 13 and has had lots of issues with her eyes and kidneys.. this new vet looks at her for 5 seconds and just because she's a little happy to see you doesn't mean she isn't in pain. I know my dogs of 13 years..she isn't enjoying life anymore and deserves whats best for her not your vet trying to give her eye ointment..she doesn't play and has lost 3 pounds in a few months.. I have been bringing her here for 13 years and I will NEVER use this vet ever again. You have no compassion for my dog.. I would NEVER recommend this vet to anyone. They are insensitive and horrible..

I would not recommend this clinic.  After paying 5,000 in examination fees, diagnostics fees and surgical fees my cat had to be euthanized 10 days after surgery.  Vet had no clue what happened even after consulting other vets.  Suggested another 1,300 plus in diagnostic fees and she might be able to  tell what why this happened,  At that point my cat was suffering and dying.  I will never use this clinic again.
I always know my dogs are in good hands as a nervous dog mom!

Just want to say how impressed I am with this clinic and their staff members from the front desk to the doctors. Dr. Fisher has been more than helpful and accommodating through his treatments and referrals to other sources when it was determined my cat needed more urgent care than they could provide. I really appreciate the follow up call to check in on her for updates after she left the facility as well. Highly recommend!

I feel I have gotten pretty good care for my baby here. She is in the end stages of congestive heart failure but is being monitored and given medicine to help prolong her life. I would recommend this place to anybody

This is a nice offer to have the first visit free but at the end of the day your first
visit can specific to something wrong with them or just a normal exam your choice. All I had to pay for was the ornament for her nose for the first visit.

I took my dog in for lump on her leg ,so they came with treatment plan for all test and med. I decided two med in which they said they would revised and bring back. The only problem with that was now the treatment plan would be higher. When I told them I would just take to another vet they tried to have me sign a refusal of treatment form

When my cat was alive, may he rest in peace, I took him to the vet back in June, he was 14lbs at 9 years old, but he wasn't really eating, they wanted me to pay almost $1000 just for blood work and examine him, I told them that I wasn't going to pay for that, I can't afford it, my heart sunk for my poor kitty, he got worse over time, the day I decided to have him put down, September 7th, the doctor said that I should give my cat to another family who could pay for the exams, he is MY baby, I have raised from a kitten to a 9 year old cat! Absolutely not! Then tells me that a human person with diabetes shouldn't be put down because they don't deserve it, but a person with cancer does deserve to be put down, WHAT?! Then expected me to pay almost $500 for an exam to try and keep him alive when he hasn't been eating for months or drinking and he was 11lbs and that was just the FIRST test with steroids in HOPING he would eat! Obviously my cat was dying! I am glad I took him somewhere else to be his final resting place than this place, because the place I took them, I paid almost 600 for the entire 24hr service and urn, plus, the doctor that put Max down shaved his arm saw his pale skin and collapsed vains, she had seen this previously with her other cats and said that Max is dying from cancer. This animal hospital is nothing but money hungry and doesn't actually care about our families we have been loyal to this location for SEVERAL years and NOW they are showing their true colors after my cat had to be put down!
I came in as a walk-in. All of the staff were nice, professional, and caring. The prices were reasonable. I highly recommend this place! Thanks for taking care of my babygirl!

I was gifted a dog, and I seen this clinic had free first time visits, I made a appointment, I waited in the lobby a hour and a half, once seen by nurse I gave her the history that the previous owner gave me and let her know his owner said she is due her shots next month, I was offered the yearly plan, I told her I will make a decision after the exam. She left out to get the dr, she came back and asked did I want to get her shots today it would be 46.95 I said not yet she goes to say well the dr won’t see you unless you get the shots, I asked well why doesn’t it say on the website must have proof of shot
Record on the website.  I felt like it was a waste of time since I needed proof of shots before my dog can be seen. That’s false advertising. I really feel like it was all about the money. I’m
Sure if it was a health concern the website would say PROOF OF SHOTS AT APPOINTMENT
We brought in our new shelter and learned a good amount about owning a shelter. They were very informative and super helpful. Will definitely be back in the future!

Very nice staff. Very caring with pets. great attention to details. Listened to our concerns.Dr. Fischer was very nice in giving details of priority to treatments concerning our dogs particular conditions. We've been coming here for probably 10++ years and will continue.

Took Angel a little survivor kitten to the doctors office for his first visit the whole staff and Dr was outstanding. What a really nice place so clean well mannered treated us like family good job. Took time and talked to us about Angel our treatment plan our options are medication options. No pressure is very nice hospitality
amazing! easily fit us in on the a weekend and we're willing to work with me on cost! thank you so much for your care and kindness! Noodle is gonna make a great pitty pet!
The staff and doctor were great! They were all friendly and informative. They helped me understand my dog's vaccines and annual tests. I appreciated the breakdown and information.

Decided on taking my Rottie to VCA bc of  these misleading 5-star reviews and after the horrible customer service I received at Jersey Village Animal Clinic.

Other than Benji at the front desk, who was always wonderful, smiling and accommodating, the service, care and consideration (and knowledge regarding diseases, symptoms & treatment!) from the vet techs and vet was extremely disappointing and overpriced.

In a span of about 6-7 months, I took my dog here a handful of times (new patient checkup/annuals, visits concerning his kidney health and digestion/GI issues). My dog is an older rescue who made it thru heart worm disease/treatments alive, so it was important for me to find a vet who'd offer him good care.

Each visit was a few hundred dollars WITH the Care Club membership and absolutely no long term resolution or treatment regarding my dog's health. They're great at recommending $300-$500 lab work though. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and continued to go back..

During our last appt, I requested a nail trim  and the vet stated my dog doesn't need a nail trim bc he's "wearing" them just fine. They looked like talons...

If you're looking for a local vet who has compassion for dogs, a vet who will convey knowledge about illness, symptoms & treatment and a vet where you're not paying $200+ per visit with no long term resolve, do more research!

Adopted our dog, Marcella, from a local shelter.  Took her to VCA for a wellness checkup.  Received test results and medications quickly.  Staff was extremely knowledgeable and friendly.  First time using VCA and it will not be the last time.

I thought the care my cat received was good. However, VCA's pricing is misleading.

I brought her in at the suggestion of my usual vet when they couldn't get her in. VCA ended up ordering lab work to include urine and fecal analysis. They were unable to collect both samples at the initial visit. I brought her back a few days later and they were still unable to collect a sample. I was sent home and instructed to bring her back under sedation for the safety and comfort of all. I brought her back the following day where they were finally able to get a urine sample, but no fecal sample. I was also told the urinalysis was paid for, but there would be a $50 charge for the collection. I thought it a bit odd but didn't question it. On our way out I was reminded to get a fecal sample within 30 days.

After successfully getting a fecal sample and bringing it in I was advised it would be $100 for the test. After questioning, I was told I wasn't originally charged for the test and I was led to believe I had been.

Unfortunately, due to the lack of financial transparency, my trust with this clinic has been damaged.

We went there yesterday to have our dog looked at. After waiting for nearly an hour to even get to the back room, they barely look at the dog. Don't listen to his heart and lungs. Don't check him out except to vaguely look at his skin and weigh him. After a few minutes, the doctor comes in and does the same thing. There was absolutely no hands-on on my dog. None whatsoever. The doctor never touched him! Then a few minutes later, the nurse/aid comes back in with the bill on it. For the visit for them to never touch my dog was $120. They wanted another $120 for a prescription, another $40 for another prescription, both of which I've found half of that price on other locations. They wanted to do an X-ray that was going to cost over $400 for the X-ray and then another almost $200 for the reading of the X-ray, they wanted to do all these various things and the final bill would have been over $1300.
